question: Should the protected Control UI optimistic-routing change be approved after a current-base owner review of its route-lifecycle and rollback semantics?
rationale: The change deliberately introduces a temporary client-side session route across asynchronous Gateway creation; the protected label requires a maintainer to own that lifecycle decision rather than an automated cleanup action.

options.title: Review and merge after refresh
options.body: Rebase or refresh against current main, then approve if the owner confirms the transient route and rollback preserve Control UI routing invariants.

options.title: Narrow the approach
options.body: Request a smaller implementation if the current global optimistic-submission state is not acceptable for the Control UI ownership model.

recommendation.title: Review and merge after refresh
recommendation.body: Rebase or refresh against current main, then approve if the owner confirms the transient route and rollback preserve Control UI routing invariants.
